title: Master QCS (bid comparison)
howToOpen: Open the event and click the Master QCS tab.

reviewed.note: Rows are labelled with the template's own field names and grouped per line item; one column per bidder (sheets/schema → layers).

groups.title: Master QCS has a column for every bidder and shows every bid value (quantities, rates, amounts, rank, totals) as the API returns it
No screen of the event looks fine while a request behind it failed, and none reports an error while its requests succeeded
